Name: Taste of Belarus
Author: immafortnox
Description:
[size=5][b]Taste of Belarus[/b][/size]

A Content Patcher mod for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] that brings authentic Belarusian cuisine and traditional drinks to Pelican Town.

Supports both [b]English[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] out of the box.

[line]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]12 Traditional Dishes & Drinks[/b] — Draniki, Kholodnik, Machanka, Potato Babka, Kolduny, Vereshchaka, Zhur, Nalistniki, Kulaga, Lidski Kvass, Krambambula, and Spiced Sbiten.[/*]
[*][b]Artisan Keg Brewing[/b] — Brew Lidski Kvass (from Bread), Krambambula (from Mead + Spice Berry), and Spiced Sbiten (from Maple Syrup) directly in a Keg.[/*]
[*][b]Natural Progression[/b] — Draniki is available from day one. Other recipes are unlocked through skill levels, villager letters, or bought from Gus at the Saloon.[/*]
[*][b]Villager Recipe Letters[/b] — Befriend Evelyn, Caroline, Gus, Marnie, Leah, Pam, and Linus to receive family recipes and warm meals in your mailbox.[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal Saloon Menu[/b] — Gus serves rotating seasonal specials (Kholodnik in summer, Machanka in fall, Krambambula in winter, etc.).[/*]
[*][b]Gift Tastes[/b] — Custom gift reactions for all 33 Pelican Town villagers.[/*]
[*][b]GMCM Config[/b] — Adjust unlock progression, balance presets, and sprite styles in-game.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Menu & Recipes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Draniki[/b] (Potato + Oil) — [i]+1 Farming[/i] (Default recipe)[/*]
[*][b]Kholodnik[/b] (Beet + Egg) — [i]+1 Speed, +1 Foraging[/i] (Caroline 2♥)[/*]
[*][b]Lidski Kvass[/b] (Bread + Sugar [i]or Bread in Keg[/i]) — [i]+40 Max Energy, +1 Farming[/i] (Farming Lv. 4)[/*]
[*][b]Krambambula[/b] (Honey + Beer + Spice Berry [i]or in Keg[/i]) — [i]+1 Speed, +1 Luck, +1 Defense[/i] (Pam 4♥)[/*]
[*][b]Machanka[/b] (Pancakes + Common Mushroom + Milk) — [i]+2 Farming, +1 Defense[/i] (Gus 3♥)[/*]
[*][b]Potato Babka[/b] (Potato x2 + Garlic + Egg) — [i]+2 Mining, +30 Max Energy[/i] (Farming Lv. 2)[/*]
[*][b]Kolduny[/b] (Potato + Mushroom + Flour + Oil) — [i]+2 Foraging, +1 Attack[/i] (Foraging Lv. 3)[/*]
[*][b]Vereshchaka[/b] (Lidski Kvass + Parsnip + Garlic) — [i]+2 Combat, +2 Defense[/i] (Combat Lv. 4)[/*]
[*][b]Belarusian Zhur[/b] (Flour + Mushroom + Egg) — [i]+2 Fishing, +32 Magnetism[/i] (Fishing Lv. 3)[/*]
[*][b]Nalistniki[/b] (Flour + Milk + Honey + Egg) — [i]+1 Luck, +1 Farming, +1 Speed[/i] (Marnie 3♥)[/*]
[*][b]Polesian Kulaga[/b] (Blackberry + Blueberry + Honey) — [i]+2 Foraging, +1 Luck[/i] (Leah 3♥)[/*]
[*][b]Spiced Sbiten[/b] (Honey + Sugar + Dandelion [i]or in Keg[/i]) — [i]+1 Speed, +2 Immunity, +1 Mining[/i] (Evelyn 4♥)[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0+) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (2.0+).[/*]
[*]Optional: Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]Unzip [b][CP] Taste of Belarus[/b] into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b] folder.[/*]
[/list]
